source_separation: document/page/title and text hashes; paired/distractor sources stay within split
synthetic_disclosure: fictional source documents for controlled version/date/units/conflict cases; not real-world corpus evidence
scale_limitation: 600 instruction rows are 120 source groups, not 600 independent documents; one epoch changes both sample count and update count
promotion: no automatic promotion; retain raw zero and each state outputs, compare paired facts/citations/refusals/EOS
